prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Computer or software programmer (preferably javascript) needed for application development
It is for a capstone project that we must develop. It is similar to google maps but instead of directions. It is with jeepney routes within Davao City with a fare generator. Depending on the desired location of the user. We would also like to include road information or news. One familiar application is the Davao Commuter’s Guide.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Monthly statement PDF generator
client: Alder Property Group
client_industry: real estate

end: 2022-09
engagement: fixed

  instead of building them on request.

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Monthly statement PDF generator (p07).

- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

Your capstone project caught my attention because it combines practical route guidance, location-based search, and useful commuter information into one application. A jeepney route finder for Davao City, especially one that includes fare generation and road information or news, is a strong product idea and a very relevant use case for a modern web app. I’d be glad to help turn that concept into a clean, usable application that’s easy to understand and pleasant to use.

I’ve built full stack applications and backend systems that need to handle real workflow complexity. One project I worked on was a Monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group, where I built a queue that renders owner statements to PDF overnight and stores them in S3 instead of generating them on request. That system handled 12k statements a month, and request timeouts went from daily to none. That experience reflects the kind of thoughtful application design that helps keep a user-facing system reliable and efficient.

For your project, I can help with:
- building the app structure and user interface
- implementing route and destination search flows
- developing a fare generator based on location and route logic
- organizing road information or news content in a clear way
- creating a responsive design that works well on desktop and mobile

Because this is a capstone project, I would also focus on keeping the application understandable and maintainable, so it’s easier for your team to present and explain. I’m comfortable working across both frontend and backend tasks, and I can help shape the project into something polished and practical.

If you’d like, I can help you plan the app’s core features first and then build it in a structured way.
